title: Count the Even Numbers
description:
# Count the Even Numbers

This program reads a list of integers (on one line, space-separated) and should print how many of them are **even**.

This program has **more than one** bug. Find and fix them all so the tests pass.

## Input

One line of space-separated integers.

## Output

The count of even numbers.

```
Input:
1 2 3 4 5

Output:
2
```
